text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki succeeded brilliantly
in making her mark in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Together, we made it through
those truly precious "first three years"—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"One holiday, while I was lost in such reminiscing,
I went to the Trainer's Office—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san.
Welcome back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We weren't supposed to have a meeting today.
I wonder if something happened.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Actually, I've been practicing a bit of magic!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Practicing here calms me down.
It makes me feel like things will go well.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Why, I wonder. Maybe
my body is remembering the training.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was able to give Fuji Kiseki a place to relax.
As I savored that quiet sense of joy—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, now that you're back,
I guess practice is just about over!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: And so, it's showtime!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki bowed respectfully.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Welcome to Fuji Kiseki's magic show!
Allow me to guide you into a world of wonder!"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Behold! No tricks, no gimmicks,
just this single coin!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With that, Fuji Kiseki took out a coin
and deftly rolled it back and forth between her hands.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I shall make this vanish into thin air!
Now, don't blink—3, 2, 1!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Ping)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Flicked into the air, the coin
spun vigorously round and round—and truly vanished!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...I... I did it...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks for watching!
How did you like my illusion?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Now, the next magic trick is this—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Fuji Kiseki pulled out a deck of playing cards, but...
to be honest, that 'done it' was impossible to ignore.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having spent three years with her, I've realized something: she is always performing the role of "Fuji Kiseki."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is exceedingly rare for her true,
unfiltered emotions to spill out like that.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Drawing a card from the deck on the desk—
Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...Oh man.
Did you hear that just now?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
...It's a high-difficulty magic trick, you see.
I don't pull it off very often.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I figured if I just treated it like the real thing,
I might get the hang of it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
It succeeded just as planned,
but my joy burst right out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With a somewhat conflicted look, she furrowed her brow
and stared intently at me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Um, would you please... keep what just happened between us?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps those words really had slipped out unconsciously,
for they seemed genuinely flustered for once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If I hadn't become her trainer, she probably wouldn't have come to the trainer's office to practice magic.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without a doubt,
I had always thought of Fuji Kiseki as the perfect entertainer.
Reflecting on that—
choice_data_list: I'm glad I got to be your trainer.
I'm so glad I could become your Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Um, I'm very honored by that, but...
...What brought this on so suddenly?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the bewildered Fuji Kiseki's sleeve,
a single coin quietly peeked out.
